---
title: "First 30 Days"
subtitle: "What should WHOOP do when a member stops training? An end-to-end product analysis on public data."
---

```{python}
#| echo: false
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import duckdb

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path("../analysis").resolve()))
from lapse_data import REPEAT, load_lapses
from survival import kaplan_meier, returned_by
import power
import readout_models

con = duckdb.connect("../data/whoop.duckdb", read_only=True)
con.sql("set TimeZone = 'UTC'")

def one(sql):
    return con.sql(sql).fetchall()[0][0]

def pct(x):
    return f"{100 * x:.0f}%"

lapses = load_lapses(con)
back14 = returned_by(kaplan_meier(lapses["lapse_days"], lapses["ended"]), 28)[0]
per_year = one("select median(n_lapses / (tenure_days / 365.25)) from dim_members where tenure_days > 0")
repeat = lapses[lapses["activity_group"] == REPEAT]
repeat_back14 = returned_by(kaplan_meier(repeat["lapse_days"], repeat["ended"]), 28)[0] if len(repeat) else float("nan")

ro = readout_models.run_all(con)
prim, d0, d30, walk = ro["primary"], ro["by_day"][0], ro["by_day"][30], ro["walking"]

pw = power.run_all(con)
n2 = int(pw["sizes"].loc[0.02, "total"])
weeks2_50k = pw["weeks"].loc[0.02, "50,000 members"]
```

WHOOP is adding proactive features such as Coach check-ins. This project asks where a proactive message could matter most, and how WHOOP should test it: **when a member stops training**. It uses three public datasets, a dbt and DuckDB pipeline, and a pre-registered experiment readout, and ends in a one-page recommendation.

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
### 1. Lapses are common and recoverable

The median member lapsed (14+ days without a workout) about **`{python} f"{per_year:.1f}"` times a year**, and **`{python} pct(back14)`** were back within 14 days. Members returning from 12+ weeks away were the most fragile: only `{python} pct(repeat_back14)` came back.

[Lapses & returns →](funnel.qmd)
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
### 2. Nudges work a little, then fade

In a micro-randomized trial, a suggestion raised 30-minute steps by **`{python} f"{prim['pct']:+.1f}"`%** (95% CI `{python} f"{prim['pct_lo']:+.1f}"`% to `{python} f"{prim['pct_hi']:+.1f}"`%), from `{python} f"{d0['pct']:+.0f}"`% on day 0 to `{python} f"{d30['pct']:+.0f}"`% by day 30. Specific walking prompts worked (`{python} f"{walk['pct']:+.0f}"`%); generic ones did not.

[Experiment readout →](readout.qmd)
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
### 3. The test is sized

To detect a 2-point lift in members coming back, WHOOP would need about **`{python} f"{n2:,}"` lapsed members**: roughly `{python} f"{weeks2_50k:.0f}"` weeks of enrolment from a 50,000-member eligible base.

[30-day memo →](memo.qmd)
:::

:::

::: {.callout-tip}
## Recommendation

Test one specific check-in on day 14 of a lapse, randomized per member, and judge it by whether members come back, **week by week**, with opt-outs and cancellations as guardrails. [Read the memo](memo.qmd).
:::

## How it is built

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  A["Public data<br/>Endomondo · HeartSteps · Google Play"] --> B["dbt staging<br/>clean, typed, tested"]
  B --> C["dbt intermediate<br/>gaps, lapses, decision points"]
  C --> D["dbt marts<br/>facts and dimensions"]
  D --> E["Python analysis<br/>survival, WCLS, power"]
  E --> F["This site<br/>Quarto"]
```

- **Every analysis page reads only the marts**, and every number on them is computed at build time; none is typed in by hand. (The data audit deliberately reads the raw files.)
- **The experiment plan was committed before any outcome was analyzed** (see the readout's commit history), and the readout replicates the published result.
- **Leakage was found and fixed.** Comparing members with their whole history, future included, overstated the "slowdown before a lapse" signal; a past-only baseline replaced it ([details](funnel.qmd)).
- **Not everything worked.** Keyword themes for app reviews were checked blind against hand labels, and only one rule held up, so the memo claims no theme shares. The [data audit](audit.qmd) explains what each dataset can and cannot support.

Code, models and tests: [github.com/SudamshuRao/whoop-first-30-days](https://github.com/SudamshuRao/whoop-first-30-days)
